# Diabetes Eye Screening record

> A structured record of a diabetic retinal screening episode for the **UK NHS Diabetic Eye Screening Programme (DESP)**. For each eye it captures the grade assigned to retinal photographs using the programme's **retinopathy (R)** and **maculopathy (M)** classification, together with the **photocoagulation (P)** and **ungradable (U)** markers. From the two graded eyes it classifies the worst-eye result, derives the **recall interval** or **referral pathway**, validates completeness, and raises flagged issues (urgent ophthalmology, routine hospital eye service referral, re-screen / slit-lamp biomicroscopy, patient overdue).
